comment: The test lane. The base config excludes tests/, so `npm run typecheck` never read a line of them and vitest only strips their types -- a type error in a test was invisible to both commands until this file existed (found while building U2d, with five errors already sitting in tests/). Same strictness as the base, deliberately: loosening it here would restore exactly the blind spot it was written to close. src/ and bin/ come along because every test imports across that boundary.
